cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Request an Exception
cards.instruction: Get someone to bend one rule first so you can treat the decision as a precedent.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Let me submit the form tomorrow. Today can be a trial extension.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Then we can discover whether it harms the form.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. Next time we won't be discussing an untested idea.
